title: calycobolus campanulatus subsp. oddonii
intro: Calycobolus campanulatus subsp. oddonii, commonly known as the Cameroon calycobolus, is a plant species native to tropical Africa, belonging to the Convolvulaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and improve wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Calycobolus campanulatus subsp. oddonii include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant also exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities, contributing to its therapeutic potential in treating various diseases.
